newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Metropolitan Lifecare sees more expansion.
newsitem.headline: Metropolitan Lifecare sees more expansion.

text.p: Metropolitan Lifecare Group Ltd said on Tuesday it planned further expansion over this calendar year after considerable expansion in 1996.
Metropolitan said it planned expansion and development in 1997 at Mt Maunganui, Auckland and Palmerston North.
The retirement village and healthcare provider earlier reported a lift in annual profit to NZ$3.31 million in 1996 from $0.53 million in 1995.
Revenue for the second half of 1996 was NZ$20.5 million compared to $14.2 million in the first half, reflecting improved results is all areas of the business.
The group's nursing home and hospital licensed beds (including the Palmerston North 50 percent-owned associate) increased by 35 percent 546 over the year.
This reflected the acquisition of the Epsom Nursing Home in May, expansion of Oakwoods in Nelson and the expansion of Crestwood in Titirangi.
A full profit contribution from these three would be realised from the second half of 1997 and throughout 1998, it said. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
